name: MSM parity GameTests
description: Behaviour-parity GameTests over the sample mods' public behaviour (vanilla and Fabric API only); run by tools/run-fabric-server --gametest (with --gametest-filter msm_parity_tests:sample_mod_*, sample_mob_* or sample_script_*) against a content jar and an ejected jar (sample_script_* against content jars only).
